epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The backend application must successfully start up and be able to receive incoming connections on port 18080.

slices.title: Fix backend application startup failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the initialization block, so that the application startup remediation is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend application code
When the application is launched
Then it must successfully start and report its health status on port 18080
Given the launched application
When a request is made to /health
Then the application must return a 200 OK response indicating it is healthy
slices.tocConstraintRef: Database connection or container startup block
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease container crash loop rate from >0 to 0
